chunks_retrieved.title: Cash on delivery
chunks_retrieved.text: COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order.

chunks_retrieved.title: Partial refunds and coupons
chunks_retrieved.text: If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivery fees
chunks_retrieved.text: Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

chunks_retrieved.title: Exchanges
chunks_retrieved.text: Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.

chunks_retrieved.title: Reverse pickup and fees
chunks_retrieved.text: Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

chunks_retrieved.title: Is delivery free?
chunks_retrieved.text: Delivery is free on most orders.
